demo.program:
# MATLAB — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created MATLAB?", "MathWorks (Cleve Moler)"),
    ("What paradigm is MATLAB?", "procedural"),
    ("What is creator?", "MathWorks (Cleve Moler)"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1984"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "procedural"),
    ("What is typing?", "dynamic"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".m"),
    ("What is hello world?", "disp(\"Hello, world!\")"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
